categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor parsing and key decoding in src/script/descriptor.cpp and src/key_io.cpp, core components of key and descriptor management.
categories.rationale: Optimizing descriptor parsing by ~30% provides concrete performance improvements for fuzzing and descriptor import operations. Author microbenchmarks show parsing time for a large multisig Taproot descriptor dropping from 127,812 ns/op to 90,253 ns/op (~29.4% speedup) by avoiding duplicate Base58Check decoding and redundant string allocations.
